name: regression-commit-history
goal: Commit the failing regression test before the fix, and show both exact results in Harness history

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Persist the failing-test commit and separate fix commit; compare unchanged tests and commands; expose exact results and links in shared app history.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing loop tests accept free-text proof on an uncommitted checkout. They never require separate Git commits, immutable test hashes or app links. Extend that standardized CLI fixture and shared evidence browser fixture.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: On ac6c026c with only standardized coverage changes, CLI red/green contract cases fail because committed proof is absent; 9 failures, 4 passing checks. The browser fails because Regression proof is absent. Logs: /tmp/harness-regression-commits-red.log and /tmp/harness-regression-history-ui-red.log; screenshot: /tmp/harness-regression-before.png. Product source is unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
